text.tspan: fft-fusion: the station + XMAC paths, their data layouts, and where each layout is written and read
Every path starts from packed VDIF in DRAM (1, 2, 4 or 8 bits a sample) and ends in visibilities [freq][baseline][product][channel] FP32 complex, summed over the subint's windows.
Solid boxes: kernels (what they hold on chip in the yellow notes). Coloured boxes: buffers in DRAM, written by the kernel to their left and read by the one to their right.
pairs), sums in registers: each value
Im += AiBrᵀ − ArBiᵀ; no shared stage
→ FP16 tile in shared memory, then
as above: reads the layout ready-made
read as written: the XMAC rearranges on chip
Im from A' = (im, −re); next tile prefetched
stage: [channel][receiver row: 16 win × (re, im)], 64 B rows, XOR-swizzled
read as written: the XMAC rearranges on chip
stores into the stage, then WMMA;
stage: [channel][plane re | im][receiver][16 win], rows 24 halves

* RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (gina18, 2026-11-20): 2 bits, 4 dual-pol subbands, 128 channels, 10 stations; best variant of each kernel. Blue: each kernel's own time (they add up to the chain, with the phase and setup kernels). Staged WMMA: xmacbench only.
The layouts, slowest index first (the last is contiguous in memory)
FP32 spectra (fused kernel → gpudifx, tiled, transpose)
— float2: a window's channels of one band are contiguous; bands 2f, 2f+1 are the pols of freq f
— __half2: the same order at half the bytes, only the nchan channels used
tensor layout (transpose or fused kernel → tensor XMAC)
[freq] [chan] [16-window block] [plane: re | im] [receiver = 2 ant + pol] [16 windows]
— half: each receiver's 16 windows (32 B) are a tensor-core row
layout path's tile (fused kernel, shared memory)
— W = 16 (or 8) windows, gathered over passes of the kernel's FFTs, then written out as 16-B runs
[channel, 16 B apart past a 128-B multiple] [receiver row] [4 chunks of 4 windows, chunk q at q ^ ((row>>1)&3)] [window] [re, im]
[channel] [plane: re | im] [receiver] [16 windows, rows 24 halves apart]
— float2, partial sums added atomically when window chunks split a sum
Where the rearrangement from channel-fastest (station order) to window-fastest per receiver (tensor-core rows) happens: in a separate transpose kernel, DRAM to DRAM (FP32 in, FP16 out);
in the station kernel's shared-memory tile (the layout path); or in each XMAC block's copy into its shared-memory stage (the staged paths), so the spectra cross DRAM once each way at 4 B a value.
